documentText:
CLINICAL TRIAL PROTOCOL: NeuroFic-002
A Phase I, open-label, single ascending dose study of NF-77 in healthy adult volunteers
Sponsor: Neurabis Labs. Protocol code NF-002. Version 0.9 (draft).

1. GENERAL INFORMATION
Title, code, draft version and sponsor are provided. Investigator and site contact details included.

2. BACKGROUND
NF-77 is a CNS small molecule. A brief non-clinical summary and rationale for first-in-human dosing are provided.

3. OBJECTIVES
Primary: safety and tolerability of single ascending doses. Secondary: pharmacokinetics. Objectives are stated and measurable.

4. TRIAL DESIGN
Open-label, single ascending dose, sequential cohorts with sentinel dosing. Dose-escalation scheme and cohort size are described.

5. SELECTION AND WITHDRAWAL OF SUBJECTS
Inclusion/exclusion for healthy volunteers and withdrawal criteria are defined.

6. TREATMENT OF SUBJECTS
Dose levels, route, and dose-escalation decision process are specified.

7. (Efficacy assessment not applicable / not described.)

8. SAFETY
Adverse events will be collected. No SAE reporting timelines, causality-assessment method, or stopping rules for safety are specified.

9. (No statistical section.)

10. SOURCE DATA
A brief line mentions monitoring will occur; no explicit direct-access statement for audit/inspection.

11. QUALITY
Monitoring is mentioned but no monitoring plan or data-quality procedures are described.

12. ETHICS
Declaration of Helsinki, IRB/IEC approval and informed-consent process are described.

13. (No data-handling or record-keeping section.)

14. FINANCING
A line notes volunteers will be compensated; no insurance arrangement is stated.

(No publication policy. No appendices attached.)
